take.title_zh: Figma Config 2026：從畫布到全能設計引擎
take.title_en: Figma Config 2026: From Canvas to Full Design Engine
take.body_zh:
Figma 在 Config 2026 大會發表一系列更新，把工具從純畫布延伸到「材質」層級——新增 code、motion、shader、生成式外掛與 Weave 工具，讓設計師能直接在同一個檔案裡完成互動原型、動畫時間軸與程式邏輯，模糊了設計與開發的邊界。

同時 Figma 也持續強化 AI 能力，包括讓設計 agent 具備即時網路搜尋，能拉取真實內容取代佔位文字，並開放組織管理 Make／Sites 檔案的發布權限。對 UXUI 與 PM 而言，這代表工具鏈正快速往「一站式生產」靠攏，值得持續關注採用曲線與團隊工作流程的調整。
take.body_en:
At Config 2026, Figma expanded beyond the canvas into new "materials"—code, motion, shaders, generative plugins, and Weave tools—letting designers build interactive prototypes, animation timelines, and logic inside a single file, further blurring the line between design and development.

Figma also pushed its AI features further: its design agent can now pull live web content instead of placeholder text, and admins gained workspace-level publishing controls for Make and Sites files. For UX and PM teams, this signals design tooling is consolidating into an end-to-end production layer worth tracking closely.

articles.title_zh: Config 2026 回顧：新材質、新工具與更具表現力的畫布
articles.title_en: Config 2026: New Materials, New Tools and a More Expressive Canvas
articles.summary_zh: Figma 在 Config 2026 大會發表一連串更新，把畫布延伸為完整的設計引擎：新增 code、motion 時間軸、shader、生成式外掛與 Weave 工具，讓設計師能在同一份檔案裡完成互動原型、動畫與程式邏輯。官方同時強化 AI 能力，設計 agent 可即時搜尋網路填入真實內容取代佔位文字，組織管理者也能在工作區層級控管 Make 與 Sites 檔案的發布權限，顯示 Figma 正加速把設計、開發與 AI 整併進單一工作流程。
articles.summary_en: At Config 2026, Figma unveiled updates that push the canvas into a full design engine: new code, motion timelines, shaders, generative plugins, and Weave tools let designers build interactive prototypes, animations, and logic in one file. Figma also deepened its AI features—its design agent can now search the live web to populate designs with real content instead of placeholders, and workspace admins gained publishing controls for Make and Sites files. The moves signal Figma consolidating design, development, and AI into a single production workflow.
articles.take_zh: 這波更新的核心是「材質化」——把程式、動畫、AI 都變成畫布上可操作的元素。設計工具邊界持續模糊化，「會用 AI agent」恐將成為設計師的基本功。
articles.take_en: The real story isn't any single feature but Figma treating code, motion, and AI as canvas-native materials. Tool boundaries keep dissolving, and directing an AI design agent may soon count as a baseline design skill, not a bonus.

articles.title_zh: 2026 年 UX 設計師必看的 AI 工具清單
articles.title_en: Top AI Tools for UX Designers in 2026
articles.summary_zh: Figma 官方資源庫整理 2026 年 UX 設計師常用的 AI 工具清單，涵蓋從線框生成、內容填充、可用性測試到程式碼轉換等環節，並說明各類工具適合導入設計流程的哪個階段。內容偏向工具地圖而非單一深度評測，適合想快速盤點市面選項、規劃團隊 AI 導入順序的設計主管參考。
articles.summary_en: Figma's resource library maps out the AI tools UX designers are actually using in 2026, spanning wireframe generation, content population, usability testing, and design-to-code handoff. Rather than a single deep review, it's structured as a landscape guide—useful for design leads scoping which AI tools to introduce at which stage of their workflow.
articles.take_zh: 這類清單的價值在於「分類邏輯」而非工具本身——把 AI 工具按流程階段分組，能幫團隊避免同時導入太多重疊功能。建議當盤點清單參考，而非採購指南。
articles.take_en: The value here is the categorization logic, not the tool list itself—grouping by workflow stage helps teams avoid adopting overlapping AI tools at once. Treat it as an inventory checklist, not a procurement guide.

articles.title_zh: 給產品經理的 UX 入門課
articles.title_en: UX for Product Managers: Building Better Products
articles.summary_zh: Figma 資源庫推出給產品經理的 UX 入門指南，說明 PM 不需要成為設計師，但需要掌握使用者研究、原型溝通與設計評審的基本語彙，才能與設計團隊有效協作、加快決策速度。內容以流程框架為主，附上 PM 可直接套用的原型檢視與回饋範本。
articles.summary_en: Figma's guide targets PMs who don't need to become designers but do need fluency in user research, prototype communication, and design review vocabulary to collaborate effectively and speed up decisions. It's framework-heavy, with templates PMs can apply directly when reviewing prototypes and giving feedback.
articles.take_zh: 這份指南其實是在幫 PM 補「共同語言」，減少來回溝通成本。若團隊裡 PM 與設計師分屬不同部門、決策鏈較長，這套框架可直接當跨部門評審的共同標準。
articles.take_en: This guide is really about giving PMs shared vocabulary to cut back-and-forth. For teams where PMs and designers sit in different departments with longer decision chains, the framework doubles as a ready-made cross-team review standard.

articles.title_zh: TOOOLS #14：Figma Motion、產品設計心理學與其他小眾工具
articles.title_en: TOOOLS #14: Figma Motion, Product Design Psychology, and More
articles.summary_zh: 設計工具週報 TOOOLS 本期彙整 Figma Motion、產品設計心理學讀物、prepros、GetCompress 等多款工具與資源，涵蓋動畫製作、素材壓縮到設計心理學等主題，屬於一次抓取多個小眾但實用工具的快訊式整理，適合設計師定期掃描補齊工具箱缺口。
articles.summary_en: This issue of the TOOOLS newsletter rounds up Figma Motion, product design psychology reading, prepros, GetCompress, and other niche-but-useful resources spanning animation, asset compression, and design psychology. It's a quick-scan format built for designers restocking their toolkit rather than a single deep dive.
articles.take_zh: 這類週報的優勢在於「發現冷門好工具」，例如壓縮、心理學讀物這種平常不會主動搜尋的類別。建議固定追蹤，而非每期都細讀。
articles.take_en: Newsletters like this earn their keep by surfacing tools you wouldn't proactively search for—compression utilities, design psychology reading. Worth a recurring skim rather than a close read every issue.
